label: Subscription Widget
purpose: Offer a subscription/recurring purchase option alongside one-time purchase, with discount messaging
_notes:
'dispalyed_prices' is spelled exactly that way in the real schema (typo preserved) — do not 'correct' it to displayed_prices. first_displayed_option/preselected_option control which purchase mode (one_time vs subscription) is listed first / selected by default. style's 'checkbox' value renders a single checkbox toggle instead of two selectable option cards — a real interaction-model change, not just a visual variant. hide_frequency controls whether the delivery-frequency selector shows at all. All *_label/_caption/_price_text/_compare_price_text/_badge_text fields are inline_richtext (no

wrapping, inline tags like / are fine) and support placeholders like [price], [compare_price], [percentage_saved]. subscription_description_text is richtext, MUST be wrapped in

tags, and defaults to a bullet-style benefits list using an [icon] placeholder per line (e.g. '

[icon] Cancel anytime

'). benefits_icon is the Material Symbols icon name substituted for [icon]; benefits_custom_icon overrides it with an image. Excluded: the entire non_selected_*/selected_* two-tone color/border palette (~20 settings), colors, color_scheme, accent_color, badge_color_scheme, checkbox_size, border_width, corner_radius, spacing_between_options, show_selected_indicators, price_layout, sub_compare_based_on, frequency_selector_type, frequency_names, frequency_dropdown_width, hide_pickers_overlay, benefits_filled_icon, subscription_badge_style, badge_radius, subscription_separator_opacity, subscription_description_font_size, subscription_benefits_spacing/icon_size/icon_color, update_prices, margins.
